Reviewed 2026-10-30T11:06Z under the #26676 ruling B (comment 6520722066). A context-free review subagent with no development context got three inputs: #27594's Target and Acceptance (with the three rulings that change how it is read: proxy preview on `examples/app-crm`, stars in the existing favorites store, no object breadcrumb → #27950), the v4 boards (`git show a7825499aa:docs/design/record-page-v2-2026-10-27/v4/…`), and this PR's "What changes". It was told not to read the source, the diff or the tests. It walked the PR head's live console in this container: `examples/app-crm` backend (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`), Console from `ui/apps/console` at head `16c257005a`, admin, zh-CN, 1440 × 900, plus 1280 and the English pack.

**Reason.** All five Target items are met. The leads title reads 「全部线索 ▾ · 5」 and no flat tab row is drawn on the table or the kanban face; filter / sort / display keep their own row. The dropdown has the always-on search, 固定 · 最近 · 全部, authored-then-saved order, view-type icons, ☆ / 📌 on hover, and 「＋ 新建视图」 (plus 「管理视图」 for an admin) at the foot. 📌 on 线索看板 makes the bare address and the sidebar entry open it; unpinning restores 全部线索. ☆ puts 「object icon + view label」 into a 收藏 group at the top of the sidebar; clicking it opens the view, unstarring removes it, and a keyboard (Space + arrows) or mouse reorder holds across a reload. Views that an authored sidebar entry already opens (setup app: 全部用户, sessions, notifications) show ☆ disabled with 「已在菜单中」 and are not duplicated, and the CRM favorites do not show in the setup app. In split mode the list keeps the same switcher, and its dropdown opens and switches views with the list body dragged to ≈464 px and at 1280. No `pageerror` in any walk.

| Target | Verdict | Screenshots |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Title is the switcher, tab row retired | met | `01-list-title-1440.png`, `07b-kanban-face.png` |
| 2 Dropdown: search, sections, order, icons, ☆/📌, ＋ 新建视图 | met | `02-dropdown-open-1440.png`, `03b-dropdown-row-hover-clip.png`, `04-dropdown-search.png`, `07-dropdown-sections-after-create.png` |
| 3 Pinned = default per object | met | `08-dropdown-pinned-kanban.png`, `09-bare-address-opens-pinned.png`, `10-bare-address-after-unpin.png` |
| 4 ☆ → sidebar 收藏, reorder, authored item not duplicated | met | `12-sidebar-favorites-one.png`, `13-favorite-click-opens-view.png`, `16-favorites-after-keyboard-reorder.png`, `17-favorites-after-reload.png`, `23-sidebar-after-unstar.png`, `40b-inmenu-sys_user-clip.png` |
| 5 Split pane uses the same switcher | met | `30-split-pane-1440.png`, `31-split-pane-dropdown.png`, `35-split-pane-list-narrowed.png`, `36-split-pane-narrowed-dropdown.png`, `38-split-pane-1280-dropdown.png` |

**Findings below the bar (none is a REWORK reason for this card):**
- minor: in split mode 「5 条记录」 is drawn twice at the list's foot (`record-count-bar` and `record-count-footer`). That is the split pane's own count bar (#27545), already noted in this PR's Acceptance notes as out of scope. `30-split-pane-1440.png`, `37-split-pane-1280.png`
- minor: the title's 「· count」 shows on the table face, not on the kanban face (the board reports no total). This PR declares it in its Acceptance notes. `07b-kanban-face.png`
- note: 最近 includes the view that is open now, so with two or three views it largely repeats 全部. `22-dropdown-recent-section.png`
- note: a newly starred view lands at the top of 收藏, not the bottom. `19b-favorites-sidebar-clip.png`
- note: 「＋ 新建视图」 opens the existing create-view dialog, whose output is a draft view (visible only under `?preview=draft`). That is the pre-existing flow, so authored-then-saved order was seen with a draft saved view only. `05b-new-view-dialog-chinese-title.png`, `06-after-create-saved-view.png`

**Not checked:** a chart face and a view with a description (the CRM app has neither); a published reader-saved view (the seed has none); reordering non-view favorites. The v4 boards predate this card (they still draw a tab row), so the reviewer used them only as a reference for the split layout.

Screenshots (48) and the reviewer's full report are in the project's files: `ui-seat2/card-27594/preview-review/shots/` and `ui-seat2/card-27594/preview-review/review.md`. The inputs the reviewer got are in `ui-seat2/card-27594/preview-review/inputs/`.
